overview: Yes, if they fulfill the academic, subject, and English language requirements of the university.

Studying in Australia provides Indian students with access to globally recognized qualifications, world-class teaching faculties, and strong post-study work rights under the Subclass 500 visa program.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide Consultancy guides students through CRICOS-registered program selection, university applications, GTE / Genuine Student requirements, and visa processing.

items: Universities may accept TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, or IELTS Academic. IELTS Academic 6.5 overall is a popular beginning point, however specific scores and component requirements differ depending on the subject and school.
English language skills and academic credentials are typically evaluated in Australian engineering programs.
Professional engineering honors degrees often take four years, while bachelor's degrees typically take three to four years.

faq.question: After Class 12, are Indian students able to pursue engineering studies in Australia?
faq.answer: Yes, if they fulfill the academic, subject, and English language requirements of the university.

faq.question: What is the duration of an Australian engineering degree?
faq.answer: While master's programs typically take one to two years, many bachelor's degrees require three to four years.

faq.question: Is it necessary to learn mathematics?
faq.answer: Mathematics is a prerequisite for many engineering programs, and some also call for physics or other science courses.

faq.question: Is taking the IELTS required?
faq.answer: The university's English language requirements must be met by students, while there are several exceptions and acceptable tests.

faq.question: What is the approximate cost of tuition?
faq.answer: Depending on the course and school, many programs cost between AUD 35,000 and AUD 70,000 or more annually.
